newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ Bank says to cut credit card rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ Bank says to cut credit card rates.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd announced on Thursday cuts to its credit card interest rates of between 40 basis points and a full percentage point, effective from January 27.

After that date, the bank's credit card interest rates will range from 12.95 percent to 16.35 percent, ANZ Bank said, adding the rates were coming down due to the central bank's three monetary policy easings since July as well as market competition.
